_comment: Sparse daily-chart overrides. Keys are ISO dates (YYYY-MM-DD). Each date can carry an 'add' list of full row objects to inject (use when The Numbers' daily table is missing a film, e.g. Disney late-reporting), and/or an 'edit' map of {normalized-title: {field: new_value}} to correct values on existing rows. The scraper applies these AFTER scraping so re-scrapes don't blow them away. Re-ranking happens automatically by daily_gross desc. Normalized title = lowercase, alphanumeric only (e.g. 'thedevilwearsprada2', 'hoppers'). Required fields for 'add' rows: title, daily_gross, total_gross. Recommended: movie_url, distributor, theaters.
